newsitem.title: USA: Best says court approves liquidation plan.
newsitem.headline: Best says court approves liquidation plan.

text.p: Best Products Co Inc said on Friday that a U.S. bankruptcy court approved its plan of liquidation, under which shareholders will not receive any distributions for their investment.
"In approving the plan, the court indicated that Best Products is insolvent," Best Products said in a statement. "Consequently, the company's shareholders will not receive any distributions."

The company also said that unsecured creditors will begin receiving partial distributions late next month, and that ultimate recoveries for creditors in this class are estimated at about 68 percent of their investment.
Holders of allowed administrative or priority claims will receive 100 percent recoveries, it said.

Best Products, which filed for protection under Chapter 11 of the U.S. Bankruptcy Code on September 24, said in January that it anticipated net proceeds from its liquidation would not fully cover creditor claims.
